memories.content: The council is a body of elected members. Its standing orders require formal adoption of the precept at the January meeting. The council has a chairperson and a clerk. The precept for next year has been prepared but not yet formally adopted.

Kettlewell Parish Council's January meeting is scheduled to occur after 2027-01-04. The meeting is the regular January meeting where the precept is to be formally adopted according to standing orders. The precept is the amount of money the parish council requests from the district council through the council tax.
